name: Track an application through three stages
short_description: Track an application through three stages once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can track an application through three stages in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Track an application through three stages means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Track an application through three stages in a fresh real-life scenario.
